The '''Model 12 repulsor mine''' was a model of [[Anti-vehicle mine/Legends|anti-vehicular mine]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and cost 1400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
